pages.name: Executive overview
pages.storyNote: Naphtha and gasoline are 60% of output, and crude distillation carries 51% of the volume.

visuals.title: Total capacity (BPD)
visuals.altText: Combined nameplate capacity of all refineries in barrels per day.

visuals.title: Production (bbl)
visuals.altText: Total barrels produced across all process units in the current filter.

visuals.title: Average yield
visuals.altText: Average conversion yield across process units.

visuals.subtext: Naphtha and gasoline account for roughly 60% of output, and crude distillation alone moves 51% of the volume.

visuals.title: Capacity is concentrated in a few sites
visuals.altText: World map with a bubble per refinery, sized by nameplate capacity in barrels per day.

visuals.title: Naphtha and gasoline are 60% of output
visuals.altText: Barrels produced by refined product category, sorted from highest to lowest.

visuals.title: Crude distillation moves the volume, not the yield
visuals.altText: Columns show barrels produced per process unit type against a line showing average yield percentage on a second axis.

pages.name: Safety & maintenance
pages.storyNote: Turnarounds absorb 94% of maintenance cost, and 7 of the 15 alarms are high-temperature.

visuals.title: Critical alarms
visuals.altText: Number of alarms raised at critical severity.

visuals.title: Maintenance cost
visuals.altText: Total maintenance spend across all work orders.

visuals.title: Preventive share
visuals.altText: Share of maintenance work orders that are preventive rather than corrective.

visuals.subtext: Turnarounds absorb about 94% of maintenance spend, so the cost profile is driven by scheduled shutdowns rather than by day-to-day repairs.

visuals.title: High temperature is the most frequent alarm
visuals.altText: Alarm count by alarm type, sorted from most to least frequent.

visuals.title: Turnarounds absorb 94% of maintenance cost
visuals.altText: Maintenance cost by maintenance type, sorted from highest to lowest.

visuals.title: Alarms cluster at the lower severities
visuals.altText: Alarm count by severity level, sorted from most to least frequent.

visuals.title: Work orders by cost
visuals.altText: Work order number, maintenance type, priority, status and cost for every work order, sorted by cost.
